author: Jaime Botero
releaseNotes: 0.235 (stable): Flair Vents integration with the established Dynamic Airflow Balancing strategy and the latest reviewed fixes. Delivered as a single Hubitat Bundle (app + Flair vents driver).
betaReleaseNotes: 0.239 (beta): Adds Flair Puck 2 support. The Flair API exposes Puck 2 as a separate resource type (puck2s) that never appears in the v1 /api/pucks responses, so discovery now queries both families (structures/{id}/puck2s and /api/puck2s, plus puck2s room relationships), onboards Puck 2 onto the existing puck driver, and polls each puck from its own endpoint family. Puck 2 readings map onto the same canonical attributes (sub-ghz/wifi RSSI -> rssi, numeric firmware-version -> firmware-version-s), and USB-powered Puck 2s no longer derive a misleading 0% battery. v1 pucks are unchanged, including devices created by earlier versions. Also includes the 0.238 fixes: scheduler-safe API retries, independent deferred retries, repaired rooms-relationships discovery, and fan-on-while-idle circulation.
